Waldron LP Has Upped Its Amazon.Com (AMZN) Holding by $1.43 Million; Valuation Rose; Valiant Capital Management LP Lowered Apple (Call) (AAPL) Stake as Stock Declined
May 23, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Waldron Lp increased its stake in Amazon.Com Inc (AMZN) by 97.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Waldron Lp bought 1,224 shares as the company’s stock rose 28.13% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 2,481 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.90M, up from 1,257 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Waldron Lp who had been investing in Amazon.Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $768.13B market cap company. The stock increased 0.10% or $1.62 during the last trading session, reaching $1583.02. About 1.08M shares traded. Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) has risen 76.78% since May 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 65.23% the S&P500.
Christopher R. Hansen decreased its stake in Apple Inc (Call) (AAPL) by 41.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Valiant Capital Management Lp sold 1.40M shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund run by Christopher R. Hansen held 2.00 million shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $338.46 million, down from 3.40 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Valiant Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc (Call) for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $916.40B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.71 during the last trading session, reaching $186.45. About 6.91 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
